decisive_items: a right renal mass with areas of fat attenuation located in the upper pole
a fatty tumor thrombus within the right renal vein extending to its confluence with the inferior vena cava
a finding known as a “renal parenchymal vascular pedicle.”
response.rationale: The vignette describes a renal mass with fat attenuation, vascular pedicle features, and a fatty renal vein/IVC tumor thrombus. Among the supplied candidates, R3 is the only applicable renal neoplastic diagnosis, so it is selected given the closed candidate set.
